scope: Proposition 3.11 (Completion coverage conditional on successful termination) of the manuscript “The maximum number of mutually unbiased bases in dimension six” (preprints/The-maximum-number-of-mutually-unbiased-bases-in-dimension-six-September-24-2026/The-maximum-number-of-mutually-unbiased-bases-in-dimension-six-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 266 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b4cc74c840c90249), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a seed ball for which the frame and bound constructions are certified. Suppose that every final unitary cell is either excluded by a certified necessary-condition test or covered by a certified phase ball as in Section 4. Then those phase balls cover all feasible Hadamard completions of the seed ball, with the equivalences specified by the phase-ball certificates. The Stage A recursion establishes precisely this conclusion if it terminates with zero unresolved cells.
